zh: Jia、Beekie--Chen--Jia 与 Ding--Lin 给出 fixed spectral/critical geometry 下的 active Orr--Sommerfeld pressure 方法；Li--Wei--Zhang 与 Jerome--Chomaz 固定三维 Squire orientation 与 lift-up 的结构代价。现有核验没有把这些结果与本项目的 time-dependent critical-point collision、Bloch rows 和 physical direct sum 同时结合。我只报告 bounded primary-source search；它不是新颖性或优先权证明。
en: Jia, Beekie--Chen--Jia, and Ding--Lin provide methods for active Orr--Sommerfeld pressure in fixed spectral or critical geometry; Li--Wei--Zhang and Jerome--Chomaz establish the structural cost of three-dimensional Squire orientation and lift-up. The checked sources do not combine those results with this project's time-dependent critical-point collision, Bloch rows, and physical direct sum. I report only a bounded primary-source search; it is not proof of novelty or priority.

en: I write the Orr--Sommerfeld pressure term as an exact signed commutator form, obtaining prefactor-one decay and forced graph estimates on the signed high-gap class; I also split Squire transfer into an exact orientation coefficient and a history convolution. en: Under \(d=\alpha^2S,\ x=\alpha X\), transport and \(V_{XX}\mathcal L_\alpha^{-1}\) have the same order. The high-gap perturbation therefore cannot pass directly through the collision; collisionScaleOSLimitingAbsorption remains OPEN.
